jobs.occupation: Nordic Buyer to Coop Trading A/S
jobs.description:
_Do you thrive in a role where you are responsible for negotiations, securing competitive prices and building a competitive supplier base? Would you like to be a part of a company that aims to create a better everyday through leading Nordic Private Brands? Then keep reading!

_As a Nordic Buyer, you will be responsible for different categories, handling supplier negotiations, market and data analysis and collaborating with colleagues and our four Nordic partners to deliver a competitive assortment in line with our strategy.

We are looking for two Nordic Buyers to join our Range & Procurement department. One position is in our Nearfood team and the other in our Food team. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to help shape private brands across the Nordics.

**Key Responsibilities

**The role covers a broad range of responsibilities, including:

• Develop and implement growth, supplier and procurement strategies within your categories that support our Nordic Private Brands goals

• Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive prices

• Stay updated on market developments within your categories

• Participate in trade shows, customer visits and supplier visits

• Negotiate and optimize efficient packaging solutions in collaboration with our Supply Chain team

• Organize inspiration days

• Conduct analyses focused on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) within your categories

• Focus on understanding and enhancing sustainability

• Develop and maintain Product and Price Lists (PPLs)

**To Thrive In This Role, We Imagine That You

**

• Have a relevant educational background for example in Purchasing and Supply Management or something similar

• Are looking for your first job or have a few years of experience within procurement

• Are skilled at communicating and building relationships with both internal and external stakeholders

• Are comfortable working with Excel and other Microsoft Office applications

• Speak and write English fluently. Knowledge of one or more Nordic languages is an advantage

• Knowledge TCO, ESG, packaging e.g. is an advantage

**Personal competencies:

**

• Curious and motivated to learn

• Commercially minded

• Structured and able to plan, prioritize, and follow through on tasks

• A team player who enjoys cross-functional collaboration

• Skilled at building positive stakeholder relationships

• Self-driven with a strong sense of responsibility and ownership

• Interested in challenging the status quo and finding smarter ways of working

**What We Offer

**

• A company where people know one another well and the culture is informal

• At the same time, you will be part of a larger Nordic setup, working with our four partners in Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland. So, while you will get to know your colleagues at our Vesterbro office well, you will build a broad network and collaborate with many different stakeholders across the Nordics

• Develop both personally and professionally, learning from skilled colleagues along the way

• Be part of a purpose-driven company shaping the future of Nordic private brands for millions of consumers

• A supportive and inclusive workplace culture that values your well-being and where you can be exactly who you are

If you are ready to join Coop Trading, please send us your CV no later than 20th of November 2026. However, we review applications on an ongoing basis.

Place of work: Vesterbro, Copenhagen

We believe that a strong culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while offering the flexibility to work from home when needed.

The role involves 30-40 travel days per year, including occasional overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Louise Fisker Langkilde at +45 27772463 and Cathrine Bohnstedt Overby at +4527772509.

If you prefer either the Nearfood or Food team, please indicate this in your application.

**About Us

**Coop Trading’s purpose is to make a better every day through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers delivering the best quality products at a fair price. Our portfolio encompasses both food and daily non-food items within our private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

Coop Trading represents Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, as well as SOK in Finland. Through our private brands, we are proud to be present on every third dinner table in Nordic homes. On behalf of our four partners, we develop products for our private brand portfolio through innovation, product development, and negotiating Nordic agreements.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Operations Manager

What we believe in:

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

Your role and tasks

Are you looking to combine your studies with practical IT experience and gain insight into how IT supports a global organization?

We are looking for a Student Worker to join the Information Systems Infrastructure team in Middelfart. In this role, you will support daily IT operations while gaining hands-on experience across several IT disciplines, including infrastructure, workplace technology, business applications, cybersecurity, compliance, and user support. The position offers the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge in practice while working alongside experienced colleagues who will support your learning and development.

You will become part of the local IT organization supporting ABB's operations in Denmark, working with both local and global colleagues to ensure stable and efficient IT services. The role is designed to provide meaningful practical experience while allowing you to gradually take on more responsibility as your skills and experience grow.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting day-to-day IT operations and general IT-related activities

• Assisting with IT hardware, workplace equipment, and infrastructure-related tasks

• Providing practical IT support and assistance to end users

• Supporting activities related to business applications and systems

• Assisting with user administration and access-related activities

• Maintaining IT documentation, inventories, and relevant records

• Supporting IT compliance activities, controls, documentation, and follow-up

• Participating in smaller IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications for the role

• Currently pursuing a relevant higher education within IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Digitalization, or a related field

• Interest in IT technologies and motivation to develop practical IT skills

• Ability to organize and prioritize tasks in a structured and responsible manner

• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with colleagues across functions

• Service-oriented approach and interest in supporting users and business stakeholders

• Interest in infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, compliance, or IT operations

• Effective communication skills in both Danish and English

• Experience with Microsoft technologies, IT support, scripting, applications, or infrastructure is an advantage but not a requirement

More about us

At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences.

You can look forward to joining a workplace that values employee well-being. We put a lot of focus on a positive work environment and invest in ongoing development for you and your colleagues.

The role is based in Middelfart and follows a hybrid work model, combining office collaboration with flexibility to work remotely when appropriate. You will contribute to a cooperative workplace in which knowledge exchange and cross-team collaboration play a central role.

If you’d like to learn more about our efforts around workplace environment and sustainability, you can read more here: ABB Sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart alongside your IT colleagues. We offer flexibility with the possibility of working from home when appropriate while maintaining close collaboration with the team.

The position reports to Jimmy Frederiksen.

Apply for the job online, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Jimmy Frederiksen at +45 44 50 40 89.

The application deadline is 29.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable, and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 110,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 550 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg. Join us. Be part of the team where progress takes place, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

#RunWithABB

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.occupation: Programme & Project Manager to Coop Trading A/S
jobs.description:
Programme & Project Manager, PMO

Are you motivated by leading projects from idea to implementation? Do you thrive on bringing structure to complexity and making real change across markets and functions? Then this could be your opportunity to make a visible difference in a Nordic organisation with strong ambitions.

We are looking for an experienced Programme & Project Manager with solid project delivery skills.

**Your Role

**As our Programme & Project Manager, you will report to the General Manager, Strategy & Business Development and be responsible for leading complex cross-Nordic projects end-to-end, from scoping and planning through execution, handover and value realisation. You will work closely with stakeholders across Coop’s organisations in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

In addition, you will support programme coordination when related projects are grouped into a programme. Here, you will establish governance and manage cross-project dependencies, progress, risks and benefits.

You will work closely with our 3 Project Managers.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Manage complex cross-Nordic projects end-to-end, from scoping and planning through execution, handover and value realisation tracking

• Establish clear project objectives, plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks and decision points

• Handle project governance, prioritisation and gate approvals based on business value, impact and capacity, in cooperation with the management team

• Support programme management by coordinating related initiatives and managing cross-project dependencies

• Ensure accurate project data and reporting in the project management system

• Improve project processes, tools, templates and onboarding materials

• Proactively manage project risks and issues to ensure smooth project delivery

**To do well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring effective communication and stakeholder management skills, plus the ability to deliver clear presentations

• Have experience leading complex cross-functional projects. Experience with programme coordination is an advantage.

• Have a solid understanding of project governance, planning, risk management and stakeholder management

• Have experience working with business cases, financials, and value tracking

• Have experience with process improvement. Lean certification is a plus.

• Have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools

• Are fluent in English, both written and spoken; knowledge of Swedish, Norwegian, and Danish is an asset

• Are a certified Project Manager (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent)

**Personal Competencies

**You are a proactive and results-driven project professional who enjoys working across functions, cultures and organisational levels.

**In Addition, You

**

• Have strong analytical capabilities and a structured approach

• Are skilled in stakeholder management and aligning others without formal authority

• Are highly organised and results-oriented

• Have strong prioritization skills and the ability to manage competing demands

• Take initiative and question existing ways of working to make improvements

• Thrive in dynamic environments where change and continuous improvement are part of everyday business

**What We Offer

**

• An important role with the opportunity to lead business-critical projects and programmes across the Nordics

• A central position in a growing PMO where you can help shape standards, ways of working, and execution discipline

• Close collaboration with internal and external senior stakeholders and broad exposure across markets, functions, and strategic priorities

• Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development in an ambitious and collaborative environment

• The chance to be part of a purpose-driven company that is shaping the future of Nordic private brands for millions of consumers

If you are ready to take the next step in your career and join Coop Trading's PMO team, please send us your CV no later than 20th of November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Place of work: Vesterbro, Copenhagen

We believe that a strong culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while we offer the flexibility to work from home when needed.

You can expect approximately five days of travel per year, with the possibility of overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact General Manager, S&BD, Gustav Gaarde at +45 2777 2575.

**About Us

**Coop Trading’s purpose is to make everyday life better through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers by delivering high-quality products at fair prices. Our portfolio encompasses both food and daily non-food items within our private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

Coop Trading represents Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, as well as SOK in Finland. Through our private brands, we are proud to be present on every third dinner table in Nordic homes. On behalf of our four partners, we develop products for our private brand portfolio through innovation, product development, and negotiating Nordic agreements.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We challenge the status quo to deliver the best and most innovative private-brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

jobs.occupation: Internship - Research Intern, Speech & Language Processing
jobs.description:
Summary

Please note this internship will be a minimum of three months, you must be enrolled as a student on a PhD course and available to start no later than 1st June 2027

Within Apple’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning organization (AIML), you can take part in the ongoing revolution that machine learning plays in daily life. Apple’s fully-integrated hardware and software provide unique opportunities to deliver amazing experiences, all while prioritizing user privacy. As an AIML intern, you will get to explore new methods, apply machine learning to solve ambitious problems, advance state-of-the art technology through research and publications, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new theories that will impact the way we understand machine learning and the experiences it can enable. Come collaborate with some of the best in the business and help build the world's most innovative products and experiences.

Description

In an AIML internship, you will collaborate with researchers, engineers, and program/project managers to tackle innovative challenges. You will also receive technical mentorship and guidance that allows you to learn new things every day, gain practical skills, build real world experience, develop a greater understanding of our industry, and form valuable connections. Together, you and your team will partner to design and implement an innovative solution for a Machine Learning problem that is meaningful. At the end of your internship, you will have the opportunity to meet and present your work to AIML leadership. Where appropriate, you will have the opportunity to submit your work for publication at a suitable conference.

We are offering a research internship opportunity to work directly with our research team in Copenhagen, Denmark on projects ranging from multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) to multilingual speech language models (SpeechLMs). The internship topic can be fitted to the candidate's interests, with example topics including language interference and cross-lingual transfer, the effect of training data composition on multilingual generalization, low-resource languages and dialects, efficient adaptation and continual learning, self-supervised and multimodal learning, and interpretability of multilingual speech models.

Minimum Qualifications

• Working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, cognitive science, computational linguistics or equivalent.

• In-depth knowledge of deep learning and statistical machine learning, with strong Python programming skills and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Research experience in multilingual or cross-lingual speech and language processing, such as ASR, speech LMs, or audio language models

• Interest in Speech and Language Processing

• Strong demonstrable record of publishing academic research in ML-related peer-reviewed venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML...), including language- and speech-specific ones (e.g. *ACL, Interspeech, ICASSP)

• Ability to collaborate with others and to deliver ML technologies aligned with Apple's core values: the highest standards of quality, scientific rigour, innovation, and respect for user privacy

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience training or fine-tuning large speech or language models

• Experience with language interference, cross-lingual transfer, or low-resource languages and dialects

• Interest in the interpretability and efficient adaptation of speech models

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

Role Number: 200692892-1419

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a talented student assistant to strengthen our embedded systems work.

As Student Assistant in Embedded Systems, you will develop the firmware that brings our photonics lab setups to life. Working closely with our engineering team, you will build STM32-based systems for signal generation, acquisition, processing, and monitoring, turning hardware into working, measurable systems. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity, and expectation, to see your code run on real lab equipment from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain C firmware for STM32 microcontrollers, ensuring robust, well-structured code that supports our lab setups and experiments.

Interfaces & Device Control: Connect, configure, and control external devices over SPI and I2C, while ensuring reliable communication between the microcontroller and the surrounding hardware.

Signal Generation, Acquisition & Processing: Generate signals and waveforms, acquire and monitor analog signals, and process the acquired data on the MCU through filtering, averaging, and feature extraction.

Lab Work & Documentation: Bring up and debug hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers, while documenting code and results clearly and maintaining version control with Git.

What We Are Looking For

Education: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related discipline.

Embedded Experience: You bring good knowledge of C and microcontroller fundamentals along with practical experience with STM32 or comparable ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.

Interfaces & Peripherals: You have hands-on experience with SPI, I2C, DMA, timers, ADC, and DAC, from configuring the peripheral to debugging it on the bench.

Electronics: You are able to read and understand electronic circuits, schematics, and datasheets. Electronics skills such as circuit design, soldering, and measurement, as well as real-world lab experience, are considered an advantage. Experience with PCB design (KiCad or Altium) and Python or MATLAB for data analysis is a plus.

Soft Skills: You are a structured and independent problem-solver who enjoys working at the boundary between hardware and software, communicates effectively with colleagues, and thrives in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required.

The Perks

We care about your growth and development. You will work on cutting-edge photonics and embedded technology alongside highly motivated colleagues, with access to a well-equipped lab. We offer competitive hourly pay, flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams, a positive culture with free snacks, and the opportunity to write your Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis with us.

How To Apply

If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV, a current transcript of records, and a few lines about an embedded project you have worked on (a link to a Git repository is a plus). We aim to fill the position as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

For more information or questions please contact us at haris@phanofi.com

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

________________________________________________________________

We treat all candidates equally, are committed to bringing in top talent from all sectors and countries, and will not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!

Do you want to help shape the strategic direction of Dalux’s international bid activities? And are you motivated by bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives to develop strong bid strategies? Then you might be our new Bid Manager!

**First, who on earth is Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish-owned international software company that digitises the construction and facilities management industries. Our solutions within BIM and digital project management are used by contractors, building owners, and consultants in more than 170 countries. With more than 50 offices and colleagues across 28 countries, we are in the midst of an exciting growth journey.

**A key role with strategic responsibility

**As Bid Manager at Dalux, you will play a central role in our commercial strategy and be responsible for driving and further developing a professional, international bid function based in Copenhagen.

You will be at the centre of our bid activities across markets and countries, bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives into one cohesive strategy. Working closely with Sales, Legal, senior management, and technical specialists, you will ensure that our bids are competitive, legally sound, and strategically prioritised.

The majority of our tenders come from international markets, meaning you will play an important role in understanding and navigating different countries’ regulations, cultures, and approaches to tender processes.

**Your key responsibilities will include:

**

• Driving and further developing a centralised bid function responsible for tender and bid processes across markets.

• Developing and shaping bid strategies in close collaboration with senior management and relevant commercial teams.

• Conducting strategic bid/no-bid assessments to ensure that Dalux prioritises the opportunities with the strongest strategic fit and greatest potential for success.

• Analysing tender documentation, identifying risks and opportunities, and challenging the basis for our participation.

• Ensuring legal quality and effective risk management in collaboration with our Legal team.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams throughout complex bid processes and ensuring progress, structure, and quality.

• Gathering and applying market and competitor insights to strengthen Dalux’s position.

• Continuously optimising processes and ways of working to make the bid function more efficient and create space for strategic work.

**This sounds like a great fit for me!

**We imagine that you have solid experience with tender and bid processes, for example as a Bid Manager, Senior Bid Specialist or so. You have a strong understanding of public and private bids and tender regulations, including relevant EU rules, and can translate legal requirements into commercial decisions.

You are interested in working internationally and motivated by learning about new markets, cultures, and local interpretations of regulations and tender processes. International experience is an advantage, but your curiosity and desire to work across borders are just as important. You communicate confidently in English.

The role is first and foremost about setting the direction, driving the process, and ensuring quality across our bids. You will not necessarily be responsible for producing large volumes of bid material yourself. Instead, you will be able to quality-assure, challenge, and bring together input from relevant commercial and technical colleagues to create a strong and cohesive proposal.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and strategic in your approach. You have a natural project management overview and the ability to create structure and drive progress in complex processes involving many stakeholders.

You are confident in your professional expertise and have the maturity and composure needed to engage with different types of people from specialists and colleagues across our international organisation to managers and senior leadership. You are able to challenge and provide direction while remaining humble in your approach and bringing different perspectives together around a shared decision.

**Be part of Dalux’s success!

**At Dalux, we are committed to creating a workplace that inspires and motivates. We believe that wellbeing and job satisfaction go hand in hand with a healthy work environment which is why we believe excessive overtime should be a thing of the past.

We have an informal yet professional culture where everyone is welcome, without strict dress codes or unnecessary titles. You will become part of an engaged community where we do not just come together for work, but also for social activities such as shared dinners, workshops, wine tastings, knitting clubs, and running clubs or whatever we come up with next.

At our headquarters in Copenhagen, you will join a dedicated team in Business Operations, and you will collaborate and spar with colleagues across our offices in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and the rest of Europe. Wherever you are, you can expect a strong sense of community and a shared focus on innovation and success for both our customers and Dalux.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

Business Consulting at Trackunit turns customer business problems into commercial outcomes on the Operating Data Platform, IrisX. The function sits between Sales and delivery: it owns the business case, shapes the commercial construct, and holds the line on what we promise and what we deliver.

We are not looking for someone who has seen it all. We are looking for someone who is ready to. Three to six years in, commercially curious, and hungry to own something real. You will work with enterprise construction, rental and OEM accounts across EMEA. Your job is to find the value they are not yet capturing, build the case for it at executive level, and make sure that value is realised after signature.

With locations in the hearts of EMEA, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations in Denmark, Scandinavia, Germany and UK or remotely from anywhere in EMEA. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

This role is ideal for someone with technical skills who is eager to make an impact in a growing market. We welcome junior candidates who are ready to learn and grow with us!

****What’s in it for you?

****Commercial ownership that is real, not symbolic. You are in the room with executives, customers and sales leadership, building the case, structuring the deal and shaping the decision. The role carries real commercial accountability from the first engagement, and your work shows up in outcomes, not just outputs.

A cross-functional role in the best sense of the word. You work daily across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering and Product. Few roles give that breadth of view or that ability to get things done across a business.

A function still being built. The Business Consulting playbook is not finished. What you learn from customers shapes how the team works and what the product prioritises. The best ideas here do not die in a document.

Time with customers. You will be on the ground with customers across EMEA, building relationships over years rather than over calls. It also means you need to be someone who finds energy in that, not someone who tolerates it.

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****Who are you ideally?

****This is a high-trajectory role, not a senior one. We are looking for someone three to six years into a career in SaaS, consulting, customer success or a commercial function, with a track record that already stands out.

• You have built a business case and defended it in front of people who pushed back, and it held.

• You read a P&L, understand how SaaS and consumption-based pricing create value, and can explain it to a CFO.

• You get things done across functions without formal authority. You influence through credibility and trust.

• You operate well in ambiguity. Priorities shift, the platform evolves and customer expectations do not always match reality. You stay composed and find the path forward.

• You are curious about technology and can hold a credible conversation with product and engineering.

• You think in terms of the team’s result and are clear about your own contribution to it.

• You will Travel regularly to customers. The role requires it.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Lead customer engagements from discovery through adoption and expansion, connecting business needs to platform capability.

• Build and present business cases to senior stakeholders, including commercial modelling and value articulation at executive level.

• Partner with Sales on complex deals, shaping pricing and consumption-based commercial structures that require both commercial and technical fluency.

• Work across Sales, Solution Engineering, Product and Customer Success so the customer experiences one joined-up journey rather than a chain of hand-offs.

• Translate platform change into clear, honest communication with customers and set expectations we can meet.

• Convert what you learn into frameworks and documentation that raise the standard of the whole team.

• Run multiple active engagements in parallel without compromising relationships or delivery quality.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We’ll go into your experience and how you work, and you’ll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex _(including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know._

Chef for a Japanese hot kitchen in Copenhagen

Restaurant Damindra in Copenhagen is looking for a chef to join our hot kitchen. We’re looking for someone with some experience cooking hot Japanese dishes who wants to build on their skills.

You’ll help with daily mise en place, cook hot dishes, and work alongside the kitchen team during service. We value a clean, organised approach, care for ingredients, and clear communication when service gets busy.

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Mid Level Backend Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Power the #1 CPMS & EV charging Platform: Build the robust, scalable infrastructure necessary to make Monta the undisputed global leader in Charge Point Management Systems.

• Scale the Roaming Network: Strengthen our existing roaming functionality. Your work will directly impact how seamlessly thousands of EV drivers connect to charging points across different networks.

• Innovate on Standards: Implement exciting new features including the latest OCPI versions and Plug & Charge capabilities.

• Turn vision into reality: Balance technical ambition with sleeves-rolled-up execution to ensure our fleet and roaming offerings remain best-in-class.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the full lifecycle: Scope out requirements and plan new features in collaboration with the team, taking code from ideation to production.

• Cross-team execution: Work closely with Roaming Ops, Product, Frontend and other Backend teams to navigate ambiguity and ensure features integrate seamlessly.

• Ensure quality at speed: Perform automated validation and verification testing while supporting your teammates with thoughtful code reviews.

• Monitor and Maintain: Utilize tools like Grafana and Loki to monitor system health, ensuring reliability for the drivers who depend on us.

• Own outcomes in a high-trust environment where we value execution over perfection.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.occupation: 3-year PhD Position in CRISPR-Based Genome Editing
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a full-time, 3-year PhD position in CRISPR-based genome editing, with a preferred starting date of 1st of January 2027.

The Research Group

The project will be conducted in the research group led by Chief Physician Maria Rossing at MDxCore, Rigshospitalet, and is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Our group consists of six dedicated researchers working within genomic medicine and translational research. We offer a collaborative research environment and excellent facilities in modern laboratories at Rigshospitalet.

Project Details

CRISPR-based genome editing offers the potential to correct disease-causing genetic variants at their source. Recent clinical successes demonstrate that precise, patient-specific genome editing is feasible, but such approaches remain exceptional and have not yet been translated into systematic therapeutic pipelines for rare disorders. This project aims to develop a patient-tailored CRISPR-based therapy for Glanzmann thrombasthenia, a severe inherited bleeding disorder caused by defects in platelet integrin αIIbβ3. Focusing on pathogenic patient variants in the ITGA2B gene, we will establish a translational workflow spanning characterization of the genetic defect, development of relevant cellular models, optimization of genome-editing strategies, and assessment of functional rescue and editing safety. The most promising strategy will be evaluated in hematopoietic stem cells and preclinical models to assess efficacy, durability, and safety. The project will thereby establish a framework for translating individualized genome editing into potential therapies for rare genetic disorders.

Application deadline: 30st of November 2026, 23:59 CET

Preferred start date: 1st of January 2027

Duration: 3 years

Requirements

We are seeking a highly motivated and ambitious scientist with the following qualifications:

• A master’s in medicine, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field, completed before the application deadline

• Experience in CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing and molecular and cell biology

• Experience with cell culture and relevant molecular and biochemical techniques

• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary research team

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• A strong interest in translational research and the development of novel genome-editing therapies

Place of Employment

The position is based in the Rossing Research Group at MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry, Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark. Rigshospitalet is one of Denmark's leading university hospitals and is located centrally in Copenhagen.

Terms of Employment

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for three years. The average working week is 37 hours. Salary, pension, and other terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for employees in the Danish Regions.

Application

The application must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” no later than 31st of November 2026 at 23:59 (Copenhagen local time).

The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

• Letter of motivation describing previous research experience, research interests, and career plans (maximum 1 page)

• CV including education, research/work experience, language skills, and other relevant skills

• Copy of Master's degree certificate

• Transcripts of relevant previous degrees

• List of publications

• Letter(s) of recommendation (optional)

Applications received by email or through other platforms cannot be accepted.

Recruitment Process

Eligible applicants will be assessed based on their CV, motivation letter, qualifications, and submitted documentation. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an on-site or online interview. All applicants will be notified once the recruitment process has been completed.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact:

Maria Rossing

Professor, Chief Physician

MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry

Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital

caroline.maria.rossing@regionh.dk

_Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

_The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

**What We’re Looking For

**You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

**What You Bring

**

• Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Career Band 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

**The Impact You'll Make

**The future of Sales and Customer Service will not be built by simply digitizing today's processes - it will be shaped by people who rethink how work gets done.

As our Forward Deployed AI Solution Engineer, you'll work closely with Sales and Customer Service teams to identify high-impact opportunities and turn AI, automation, and digital technologies into practical solutions that improve how we work.

This role is for a curious problem-solver who enjoys challenging the status quo, experimenting with emerging technologies, and creating measurable business value. Your impact will be seen through improved productivity, better decision-making, stronger adoption, and enhanced experiences for employees and customers.

From AI copilots and intelligent automation to digital workflows and data-driven insights, you'll help shape the future of how Sales and Customer Service teams work at Danfoss Climate Solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Serve as the AI and Digital Transformation lead for your commercial domain (Sales or Customer Service), driving adoption of innovative technologies and new ways of working.

• Identify and deliver opportunities that reduce manual effort, simplify processes, increase productivity, and create better experiences for employees and customers.

• Inspire stakeholders by demonstrating what is possible with AI, helping teams move from experimentation to business value.

• Evaluate business impact by measuring adoption, efficiency gains, and user feedback, ensuring solutions deliver real value.

• Capture best practices and reusable solution patterns that help accelerate AI adoption across commercial functions.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Someone to constantly challenge "the way we've always done it" and help unlock entirely new ways of working through AI, automation, and data-driven decision making.

• At least 3 years of experience in sales or customer excellence, project management, solution engineering, technical consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI enablement, or a similar hands-on role.

• Experience working closely with business stakeholders and translating business problems into practical digital or AI-enabled solutions.

• Strong understanding of commercial processes such as sales operations, customer support, pricing, quotations, CRM, or product data management.

• An advantage if experience with modern digital technologies such as APIs, automation platforms, AI solutions, low-code tools, SQL, Python, or similar technologies.

• Strong analytical thinking, excellent English communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across business and engineering teams.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape the future of commercial operational excellence by using AI and digital technologies to solve meaningful business challenges with real, measurable impact.

• Grow your career through continuous learning, exposure to emerging AI technologies, and collaboration with global experts across Sales, Customer Service, Digital, Data, and AI.

• Enjoy the autonomy to experiment, innovate, and bring your ideas to life in an environment that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

• Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, knowledge is shared, and teams succeed together across functions and borders.

• Receive the flexibility and support to do your best work, helping you balance professional growth with your wellbeing while making a meaningful difference.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Join a strategically important programme at the heart of the VELUX Group. The role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to influence key decisions that shape the future of the business.

What We Offer

In this role, you will play a central part in driving governance, decision-making and execution within a complex, cross-functional programme. You will have the opportunity to work across strategic, commercial, financial and operational dimensions while partnering with leaders across the organisation.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

What You Will Bring

You are an analytical and structured professional who enjoys creating alignment, momentum and clarity in complex environments. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are confident engaging with senior stakeholders while fostering strong cross-functional collaboration.

• Hold a relevant higher education degree.

• Have experience supporting governance structures or programme offices for complex, cross-functional initiatives involving senior executives.

• Bring strong capabilities in structured problem-solving, analytical thinking, stakeholder management and executive communication.

• Have experience within negotiation, change management and organisational alignment.

• Possess a solid understanding of business cases and the financial logic underpinning strategic decisions.

• Can translate complex and technical topics into concise and impactful communication for senior leadership.

• Are comfortable operating between strategic direction and operational execution.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Thrive when driving progress through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority.

• Value teamwork and actively contribute to an inclusive, constructive and high-performing culture.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.
